items.title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review

sentences.en: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review.
sentences.zh: ReviewBench ： AI代码审查的开放基准。

sentences.en: Agentic code review is becoming an essential piece of how development happens.
sentences.zh: 代理代码审查正在成为开发过程中必不可少的一部分。

sentences.en: It helps you inspect pull requests, catch issues, and decide what deserves attention before code ships.
sentences.zh: 在代码发布之前，它可以帮助您检查拉取请求、捕获问题并确定哪些内容值得关注。

sentences.en: But the quality of existing AI reviewers can be hard to measure, and you need to know the strengths of a reviewer before you know if it will help you.
sentences.zh: 但是，现有人工智能审核员的素质可能很难衡量，您需要了解审核员的优势，然后才能知道它是否会对您有所帮助。

sentences.en: Some reviewers surface more issues, some produce less noise, and some are stronger at catching critical problems while others surface smaller improvements, too.
sentences.zh: 一些审稿人发现了更多的问题，一些人发现了更少的噪音，一些人更善于发现关键问题，而另一些人则发现了更小的改进。

sentences.en: You may need code review to do different things within your workflow.
sentences.zh: 您可能需要进行代码审查，以便在工作流程中执行不同操作。

sentences.en: That makes it important to understand how reviewers actually compare: what different systems catch, what they miss, and the tradeoffs they make.
sentences.zh: 因此，重要的是要了解审稿人实际上是如何比较的：不同的系统捕获了什么，他们错过了什么，以及他们做出的权衡。

sentences.en: A good code review benchmark should reflect the diversity of real pull requests, capture a broad set of review findings, and support meaningful breakdowns by severity, category, and precision-recall preferences.
sentences.zh: 良好的代码审查基准应反映真实拉取请求的多样性，捕获广泛的审查结果，并支持按严重程度、类别和精度召回偏好进行有意义的细分。

sentences.en: For teams building code review agents, the benchmark should also provide an offline signal that reliably tracks whether changes are likely to improve the experience in production.
sentences.zh: 对于构建代码审核代理的团队，基准还应提供一个离线信号，可靠地跟踪更改是否可能改善生产体验。

sentences.en: Existing benchmarks often make tradeoffs between label quality, coverage, and how well they represent real-world code review, leaving a gap for a rigorous and reproducible evaluation methodology that brings these pieces together.
sentences.zh: 现有的基准通常会在标签质量、覆盖范围以及它们在多大程度上代表了真实世界的代码审查之间做出权衡，从而为将这些部分结合在一起的严格且可重复的评估方法留下了空白。

sentences.en: We built ReviewBench , a new code review offline benchmark , to address that gap, and it is available for you to use today.
sentences.zh: 我们构建了ReviewBench ，这是一个新的离线代码审查基准，以弥补这一差距，现在您可以使用它。

sentences.en: It follows the language, repo size, and size distribution of pull requests, modeled after over 100 million real pull requests on GitHub.
sentences.zh: 它遵循拉取请求的语言、存储库大小和大小分布，模拟了GitHub上超过1亿个真实拉取请求。

items.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI, Q3 service availability updates, Kiro workflows, and more (October 5, 2026)

sentences.en: AWS Weekly Roundup: Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI, Q3 service availability updates, Kiro workflows, and more (October 5, 2026).
sentences.zh: AWS每周综述：基于OpenAI的亚马逊基岩托管代理、第三季度服务可用性更新、KIRO工作流程等（ 2026年10月5日）。

sentences.en: Last week, we announced a public preview of Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents powered by OpenAI , built on a customized version of OpenAI’s Agents API engineered to be AWS-native and integrated with AWS resources.
sentences.zh: 上周，我们发布了由OpenAI提供支持的Amazon Bedrock Managed Agents的公开预览版，该预览版基于定制版本的OpenAI Agents API ，旨在实现AWS原生并与AWS资源集成。

sentences.en: You can now build agents optimized for OpenAI models that run entirely inside AWS with the identities, permissions, and governance controls you already use.
sentences.zh: 您现在可以构建针对OpenAI模型进行优化的代理，这些模型完全在AWS中运行，并具有您已经使用的身份、权限和治理控制。

sentences.en: You can choose an execution environment: self-hosted compute to use an existing development machine, container, or compute environment or Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, for managed runtime sessions and configurable storage in your AWS account.
sentences.zh: 您可以选择执行环境：使用现有开发机器、容器或计算环境的自托管计算，或Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime ，用于托管运行时会话和AWS帐户中的可配置存储。

sentences.en: To learn more, visit the Amazon Bedrock documentation .
sentences.zh: 如需了解更多信息，请访问Amazon Bedrock文档。

sentences.en: In addition, we are adding new frontier models on Amazon Bedrock to expand your model choices: OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol : An upgrade to GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6.1 Sol delivers exceptionally strong performance on agentic coding, computer use, and professional work.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们正在Amazon Bedrock上添加新的前沿型号，以扩展您的型号选择： OpenAI GPT-6.1 SOL ：升级到GPT-6 SOL ， GPT-6.1 SOL在代理编码、计算机使用和专业工作方面提供异常强大的性能。

sentences.en: According to OpenAI, it approaches GPT-6 Astra across demanding evaluations at roughly one-fifth of the cost, giving developers more room to build and run capable agents at scale.
sentences.zh: 根据OpenAI的说法，它以大约五分之一的成本在要求苛刻的评估中接近GPT-6 Astra ，为开发人员提供了更大的空间来大规模构建和运行有能力的代理。

sentences.en: To learn more, visit the GPT-6.1 Sol model card .
sentences.zh: 如需了解更多信息，请访问GPT-6.1 SOL型号卡。

sentences.en: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra UltraFast mode : Ultrafast is a premium speed tier for GPT-6 Astra, built for workloads where speed matters most.
sentences.zh: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra UltraFast模式： Ultrafast是GPT-6 Astra的高级速度层，专为速度最重要的工作负载而构建。

sentences.en: According to OpenAI, Ultrafast delivers up to 6x faster inference in the API, with up to 300 tokens per second.
sentences.zh: 根据OpenAI的说法， Ultrafast在API中提供高达6倍的速度推理，每秒最多300个代币。

sentences.en: The Amazon Bedrock inference engine delivers the performance, security, and reliability required for production workloads.

items.title: One year later: the power of 1.1.1.1 interns

sentences.en: One year later: the power of 1.1.1.1 interns.
A year ago, many companies were cutting intern and new-graduate hiring .
We went the other way.
We announced a goal to hire as many as 1,111 interns in 2026, a number that’s a nod to 1.1.1.1, our public DNS resolver.
The bet was that AI makes early-career talent more valuable and able to make an impact faster.
The best AI tools help people learn a system faster, try more ideas, and take on harder problems.
They don’t supply the energy, curiosity and fresh eyes a new person brings to a team.
A year in, and our interns are shipping to our internal teams and to millions of customers.
If you’re reading this on the Cloudflare Blog, you’re already using some of their work.
The blog runs on EmDash , and EmDash’s second maintainer started at Cloudflare as an intern this past summer.
A new generation of builders We’re still working toward 1,111.
So far, we’ve hosted 750 internships across 48 teams in nine offices: Austin, San Francisco, London, Lisbon, New York, Singapore, Bengaluru, Washington DC, and Sydney.

items.title: Everything we launched during Birthday Week 2026

sentences.en: Everything we launched during Birthday Week 2026.
sentences.zh: 我们在2026年生日周期间推出的所有内容。

sentences.en: We celebrated our 16th birthday last week by sharing how we’re building a better Internet for today’s world.
sentences.zh: 上周，我们通过分享我们如何为当今世界构建更好的互联网来庆祝我们的16岁生日。

sentences.en: As Matthew and Michelle reflected in this year’s Founders’ Letter , this year saw some of the most consequential changes in the history of the Internet.
For the first time, automated traffic surpassed human activity.
AI is empowering people to build like never before, leading the Internet to grow massively in scale and unlocking more ambition and creativity.
As we witnessed the influence that agent-driven recommendations have on consumer choices, we identified the need for a new approach that creates space for new businesses to succeed.
Each day of Birthday Week explored a different way we are helping to build the future of the Internet.
We began on Monday by strengthening our commitment to open source.
Tuesday focused on application security and the post-quantum transition.
On Wednesday, we explored new economic models for the agentic Internet.
Thursday, we expanded the Developer Platform with new tools for data analysis, storage, AI, and agent development.
Finally, we closed out the week by launching features that make Cloudflare faster, easier to operate, and more accessible to everyone.

sentences.zh: 调查发现， FlyDubai袭击者打算将飞机撞入特拉维夫机场。

sentences.en: The ongoing investigation has found the attacker intended to crash the plane into Israel's Ben Gurion International Airport, a person familiar with the matter but not authorized to speak publicly told NPR.
sentences.zh: 正在进行的调查发现，袭击者打算将飞机撞向以色列的本古里安国际机场，一位熟悉此事但无权公开发言的人告诉NPR。

items.title: Nobel medicine prize goes to 3 scientists for research into brain activity

sentences.en: Nobel medicine prize goes to 3 scientists for research into brain activity.
sentences.zh: 诺贝尔医学奖授予3位研究大脑活动的科学家。

sentences.en: The Nobel Prize in medicine was awarded Monday to three scientists working on the mechanisms the brain uses to switch on, or off, the activity of individual nerve cells.
sentences.zh: 诺贝尔医学奖于周一颁发给三位科学家，他们致力于研究大脑用于开启或关闭单个神经细胞活动的机制。

items.title: Quebec poised to elect separatists to power for first time in more than a decade

sentences.en: Quebec poised to elect separatists to power for first time in more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 魁北克准备在十多年来首次选举分离主义分子掌权。

sentences.en: Parti Québécois promises to hold independence referendum in Canada’s French-speaking region by 2028 Voters in Quebec are going to the polls in provincial elections which will probably result in victory for a party that has promised to hold a referendum on independence from Canada within the next two years.
sentences.zh: 魁北克党承诺到2028年在加拿大法语区举行独立公投魁北克选民将参加省级选举的投票，这可能会导致一个承诺在未来两年内举行脱离加拿大独立公投的政党获胜。

sentences.en: If polls are correct, the Parti Québécois (PQ) will form the government of the province of roughly nine million, the first time that the separatist movement will have gained power in the French-speaking region for more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 如果民意调查是正确的，魁北克党（ PQ ）将组建约900万人的省政府，这是十多年来分离主义运动首次在法语地区掌权。

items.title: Sass Jordan, Canadian rock singer-songwriter, dies aged 65

sentences.en: Sass Jordan, Canadian rock singer-songwriter, dies aged 65.
sentences.zh: 加拿大摇滚歌手兼词曲作者萨斯·乔丹（ Sass Jordan ）去世，享年65岁。

sentences.en: Musician who had hit albums with Racine and Rats later became a judge on six seasons of Canadian Idol Sass Jordan, the singer-songwriter who became a significant success in Canada’s rock scene in the 1990s before starring as a judge on Canadian Idol, has died aged 65.
sentences.zh: 曾与Racine和Rats合作过专辑的音乐家后来成为加拿大偶像Sass Jordan六季的评委，这位创作歌手在20世纪90年代在加拿大摇滚界取得了重大成功，之后担任加拿大偶像的评委，现年65岁。

sentences.en: No cause of death has been given.
sentences.zh: 未提供死亡原因。

sentences.en: A statement on social media said she died on 2 October “surrounded by her loving family … She remains in our hearts, an inimitable force of nature.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上的一份声明称，她于10月2日去世， “被她充满爱心的家人包围......她仍然在我们心中，这是一种无与伦比的自然力量。

sentences.en: An irreplaceable being of light and joy!” Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 光明和欢乐的不可替代的存在！ ”继续阅读。

items.title: Extreme heat warnings issued for parts of southern California

sentences.en: Extreme heat warnings issued for parts of southern California.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州南部部分地区发布极端高温警报。

sentences.en: Temperatures in US state forecast to hit high 30s celsius this week, while regions in Indonesia grapple with wildfires The National Weather Service in the US has issued extreme heat warnings for parts of southern California, including Los Angeles, until Thursday, as temperatures are expected to hit the high 30s celsius.
sentences.zh: 美国各州的气温预计本周将达到30摄氏度，而印度尼西亚各地区正在努力应对野火美国国家气象局已向包括洛杉矶在内的南加州部分地区发出极端高温警告，直到周四，因为气温预计将达到30摄氏度。

sentences.en: Burbank, a suburb north of Los Angeles, recorded 39C on Saturday, a few degrees shy of the October record for the region set in 1987.
sentences.zh: 伯班克是洛杉矶北部的一个郊区，周六录得39摄氏度，比1987年创下的该地区10月份的纪录低了几度。

sentences.en: A persistent area of high pressure will remain in place this week, leading to further hazardous hot weather and increased fire risk.
sentences.zh: 本周将保持持续的高压区域，导致进一步的危险炎热天气和增加的火灾风险。

sentences.en: Parts of Indonesia are in the midst of an extreme wildfire season, which has peaked over the past month.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚的部分地区正处于极端的野火季节，该季节在过去一个月中达到顶峰。

sentences.en: Western Kalimantan (Borneo) and southern Sumatra have been particularly badly affected.
sentences.zh: 西加里曼丹（婆罗洲）和苏门答腊南部受到特别严重的影响。

sentences.en: The lack of rainfall has dried the usually water-logged tropical soils, meaning that fires have been able to spread quickly, above and below the surface.
sentences.zh: 缺少降雨使通常被水淹没的热带土壤干涸，这意味着火灾能够迅速蔓延到地表上下。

sentences.en: Indonesia’s soils are also extremely rich in peat, meaning that the smoke produced from the fires contain higher levels of toxic gases such as sulphur dioxide and carbon monoxide.
sentences.zh: 印度尼西亚的土壤也富含泥炭，这意味着火灾产生的烟雾含有较高水平的有毒气体，如二氧化硫和一氧化碳。

sentences.en: Cities in surrounding areas and as far as Malaysia and Singapore have experienced reduced air quality in recent weeks as a result.
sentences.zh: 最近几周，周边地区以及马来西亚和新加坡的空气质量有所下降。

sentences.en: Drought and wildfires are more common in this part of the world during El Niño events owing to suppressed thunderstorm activity.
sentences.zh: 在厄尔尼诺现象期间，由于雷暴活动受到抑制，干旱和野火在世界的这个地区更为常见。

items.title: Skull fractures suggest servants of Egypt’s ancient kings were sacrificed

sentences.en: Skull fractures suggest servants of Egypt’s ancient kings were sacrificed.
sentences.zh: 颅骨骨折表明埃及古代国王的仆人被牺牲了。

sentences.en: Study of remains taken from royal cemetery at Umm el-Qa’ab appears to confirm early Egyptologist’s theory Court officials and craftspeople serving early Egyptian kings may have been sacrificed when their ruler died, according to research that found fractures in several ancient skulls.
sentences.zh: 对Umm el-Qa 'ab皇家墓地遗骸的研究似乎证实了早期埃及古物学家的理论。根据一项研究，法院官员和为早期埃及国王服务的工匠可能在他们的统治者去世时被牺牲了，该研究发现了几个古老的头骨骨折。

sentences.en: The royal cemetery of Umm el-Qa’ab near Abydos features the tombs and enclosures of the First Dynasty rulers of Egypt, and dates as far back as 3,000BC.
sentences.zh: Abydos附近的Umm el-Qa 'ab皇家公墓设有埃及第一王朝统治者的坟墓和围栏，其历史可以追溯到公元前3000年。

items.title: Brazil presidential election 2026: first-round live results

sentences.en: Brazil presidential election 2026: first-round live results.
sentences.zh: 2026年巴西总统大选：首轮现场结果。

sentences.en: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is standing against Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round of the presidential race Brazil’s president is directly elected: each voter’s ballot counts equally and there is no electoral college.
sentences.zh: 路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）在第一轮总统竞选中与弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）对抗巴西总统是直接选举产生的：每个选民的选票都是平等的，没有选举团。

sentences.en: If no candidate wins more than 50% of the valid votes cast in the first round, a second runoff election will be held three weeks later between the two candidates who polled highest.
sentences.zh: 如果没有候选人在第一轮投票中赢得超过50 ％的有效选票，则将在三周后在投票率最高的两名候选人之间举行第二轮决选。
